tenders.buyer_name: Krapkowickie Centrum Zdrowia Sp. z o.o.
tenders.english_summary: This is a two-part tender issued by Krapkowickie Centrum Zdrowia (Health Center) in Poland for medical equipment procurement. Part 1 covers general medical equipment supply, while Part 2 specifically requests an IT system for cardiology, with detailed specifications provided in separate annexes to the tender documentation.
tenders.what_they_want: Part 1 - Medical equipment (specific items detailed in Annex 1.1); Part 2 - IT system for cardiology (specifications in Annex 1.2). Annexes contain minimum quality and technical requirements for the requested equipment.

tenders.english_summary: The University Hospital of Antwerp is procuring medical consumables for patient hygiene and care, including pre-moistened washing cloths, dry shampoo caps with antibacterial properties (minimum 2% Chlorhexidine Digluconate), and incontinence care products.

tenders.english_summary: This tender is for the supply of sterilization and disinfection equipment to a hospital in Poprad, Slovakia. The procurement includes a pass-through steam sterilizer, low-temperature hydrogen peroxide sterilizer, and a disinfection washer.
tenders.what_they_want: Pass-through steam sterilizer (Parný sterilizátor prekladový), low-temperature hydrogen peroxide sterilizer (nízkoteplotný peroxidový sterilizátor), and disinfection washer (dezinfekčná umývačka). Detailed specifications are contained in Annex C of tender documents.

tenders.english_summary: This is a tender for a 4-year framework agreement for the supply of single-use sterile, implantable, partially absorbable surgical meshes for reconstruction of abdominal defects, inguinal and ventral hernias. Deliveries will be made via consignment stock based on buyer's orders as needed.
tenders.what_they_want: Single-use sterile, implantable, partially absorbable surgical meshes for reconstruction of abdominal defects, inguinal and ventral hernias; partially absorbable surgical meshes with adhesive gel for open and laparoscopic operations on inguinal, ventral, incisional and other types of hernias, enabling tissue fixation with minimal need for fixation devices.

tenders.english_summary: This is a tender for continuous supply of multiplex PCR kits for detection of high numbers of pathogens for the General University Hospital in Prague. The selected supplier must also provide one Real-time PCR thermocycler on free loan for the contract duration, including free servicing and regular maintenance.
tenders.what_they_want: Multiplex PCR kits for detection of high numbers of pathogens (consumable materials); 1 unit of Real-time PCR thermocycler (to be provided on free loan with free servicing and maintenance)

tenders.english_summary: Bærum municipality in Norway is tendering for a framework agreement to supply medical consumables and incontinence products, including the operation of a stand-by warehouse for these items.
tenders.what_they_want: Medical consumables, incontinence products, and operation/management of a stand-by warehouse for storing these supplies.

tenders.original_title: Estonia – Disposable non-chemical medical consumables and haematological consumables
tenders.english_summary: This is a tender for disposable non-chemical medical consumables and haematological consumables, specifically various resterilizable and sterile tubing systems compatible with different medical pumps and devices used in surgical procedures (Olympus, Storz, Nouvag brands).
tenders.what_they_want: Resterilizable two-branch tubing system compatible with Olympus Eco Pump; Resterilizable CO2 insufflator tubing for Olympus UHI-4 device; Two-branch tubing system compatible with Olympus HysteroFlow device (sterile); Two-branch tubing system compatible with Olympus HysteroFlow II device (sterile); Irrigation system compatible with Olympus pump (type PM304, REF 2502CE0542/E0497800, sterile); Two-branch tubing system compatible with Storz Endomat Select UP220 pump (sterile); Single-branch tubing system compatible with Nouvag device (Dispenser DP30, REF 4180, sterile); Silicone tubing 8x12mm, 15-30m roll (autoclavable)

tenders.english_summary: This tender is for the procurement of a comprehensive range of surgical gauzes, bandages, and medical dressings. The items include both sterile and non-sterile cotton gauze products (including laparotomy sponges with radiopaque markers), various types of bandages (elastic, plaster, adhesive), medical tapes, cotton wool, wound dressings, and specialized items like tracheostomy dressings and ocular compresses in various sizes.
tenders.what_they_want: Non-sterile laparotomy gauze with radiopaque thread/bar in cotton (with and without ribbons); sterile and non-sterile folded gauze compresses in cotton with/without radiopaque markers (various layers); non-sterile cotton gauze compresses in various sizes; soft round tampons (non-sterile) with radiopaque thread in various sizes; cotton gauze bandages (non-sterile) in various sizes; sterile gauze packing in various sizes; cloth medical tape on rolls in various sizes; synthetic wadding and hydrophilic cotton wool (gold quality, non-sterile); non-sterile TNT (non-woven) compresses without radiopaque markers (4 layers); zinc oxide elastic bandages; universal elastic support and fixation bandages; skin protectors for adhesive bandaging; medium-stretch non-adhesive compressive elastic bandages; adhesive and non-adhesive elastic bandages; self-adherent fistula bandages; fast-setting plaster bandages (fixed/natural) in various sizes; clavicle immobilization bandages; shoulder and arm immobilization bandages; arm slings in various sizes; artificial silk medical tape on rolls; non-woven medical tape on rolls; polyethylene medical tape on rolls; extensible TNT tape for dressing fixation; pre-cut plastic film plasters with absorbent compress; sterile adhesive TNT dressings with absorbent compress in various sizes; central and peripheral venous catheter fixation dressings in sterile polyurethane; sterile adhesive ocular compresses in cotton or TNT; non-adhesive sterile polyurethane foam tracheostomy dressings.

tenders.english_summary: This is a tender for the procurement of various types of medical gloves including surgical gloves, nitrile gloves, latex gloves, household gloves, cotton gloves, disposable PE gloves (sterile and non-sterile), copolymer gloves, patient restraint gloves, cleanroom gloves, finger cots, and chemical/microorganism protection gloves by a clinical hospital center in Croatia.
tenders.what_they_want: Surgical gloves, nitrile gloves, latex gloves, household gloves, cotton gloves, single-use PE gloves (sterile and non-sterile), copolymer gloves, patient self-injury prevention gloves, sterile latex gloves for cleanroom work (Class A/B), rubber finger cots, protective gloves against chemicals and microorganisms.

tenders.buyer_name: Uniwersyteckie Centrum Kliniczne Warszawskiego Uniwersytetu Medycznego
tenders.english_summary: This is a tender notice from the University Clinical Centre of the Medical University of Warsaw in Poland for the procurement of medical consumables. tenders.what_they_want: Medical consumables divided into 7 parts (Część nr 1 through Część nr 7). Specific device types, models, or brands are not specified in the available notice text.

tenders.original_title: Poland – Instruments for anaesthesia and resuscitation
tenders.buyer_name: Samodzielny Publiczny Szpital Kliniczny im. A.Mielęckiego Śląskiego Uniwersytetu Medycznego w Katowicach

tenders.original_title: Sweden – Parts and accessories for hearing aids

tenders.what_they_want: Bone-anchored hearing aid sound processors (benledda ljudprocessorer), including both bone conduction sound processors with snap coupling attachments (snäppfäste) and other bone conduction sound processors.

tenders.english_summary: Bærum municipality in Norway is seeking a framework agreement for the supply of medical consumables and incontinence products, including the operation of a stand-by warehouse to meet the municipality's needs.
tenders.what_they_want: Medical consumables, incontinence products, and stand-by warehouse operation services

tenders.english_summary: This is a tender for the supply of operating theatre devices and accessories for the Clinic of Orthopedics and Spine Surgery at Fakultní nemocnice Brno (University Hospital Brno) in the Czech Republic. The procurement includes 6 sets of operating room instruments, charging batteries, and optionally up to 6 additional sets that may be ordered within 12 months of contract effectiveness.
tenders.what_they_want: 6 sets of instruments/devices for operating theatres; 2 pieces of Li-Ion rechargeable batteries; 1 battery charger; optional additional 6 sets of operating theatre instruments (purchasable within 12 months of contract signing based on buyer's call-off).

tenders.buyer_name: Caritasverband für die Diözese Speyer e.V.

tenders.what_they_want: Ceiling lift systems (Deckenliftsysteme) for patient handling and treatment of sick patients

tenders.english_summary: This is a procurement for work chairs (seating aids) for adults and children under ISO codes 180903 and 280903 for the Medical Aids Center in Jönköping County, Sweden.
tenders.what_they_want: Work chairs/seating aids for adults and children classified under ISO codes 180903 (chairs for postural support - adults) and 280903 (chairs for postural support - children) for the Medical Aids Center (Hjälpmedelscentralen).

tenders.original_title: Sweden – Clothing, footwear, luggage articles and accessories

tenders.what_they_want: Area A - Work clothing for healthcare personnel; Area B - Profile/uniform clothing for successive orders and deliveries

tenders.english_summary: This tender is for the supply of operating tables with accessories for two departments (ENT and Urology) at Fakultní nemocnice Bulovka hospital in the Czech Republic, including warranty, post-warranty, and non-warranty service provision.
tenders.what_they_want: Operating tables with accessories for ENT (Otolaryngology) department and operating tables with accessories for Urology department, plus warranty, post-warranty, and non-warranty servicing.

tenders.buyer_name: Caritasverband für die Diözese Speyer e.V.
tenders.english_summary: This tender is for the supply and installation of ceiling lift systems for the treatment of sick persons and patients by Caritasverband für die Diözese Speyer e.V. in Germany.
tenders.what_they_want: Ceiling lift systems (Deckenliftsystemen) for patient handling and treatment purposes

tenders.what_they_want: Vacuum biopsy unit (jednotka pro vakuovou biopsii) with warranty service for 24 months and post-warranty service available as needed. Detailed specifications are contained in Annex 2 of the tender documentation.

tenders.english_summary: The Finnish Defence Forces is procuring two veterinary training simulator units that replicate military working dogs for tactical combat casualty care training, with an option for one additional unit by end of 2028. tenders.what_they_want: Two (2) veterinary training simulator units that imitate a military working dog (MWD) for K9TCCC (K9 Tactical Combat Casualty Care) training, plus option for one (1) additional simulator unit; accessories and components necessary for operating the simulator; spare parts; maintenance and repair services; customer support.

tenders.english_summary: This procurement is for a framework agreement covering central venous catheters (CVK), venous ports, PICC-lines, and NRFit products for delivery to Region Norrbotten in Sweden.
tenders.what_they_want: Central venous catheters (CVK), venous ports (venport), PICC-lines, and NRFit products

tenders.buyer_name: Departamento de Salud de Orihuela. Dirección Económica-Gerencia
tenders.english_summary: This tender is for the procurement of reagents and materials for the Hematology Area of the Clinical Analysis Laboratory at Hospital Vega Baja, specifically for oral anticoagulation treatment (OAT) testing. tenders.english_summary: This is a tender from CPAM de Paris (primary health insurance fund of Paris) for the acquisition of orthodontic supplies and aligner treatment products for their dental center. The procurement specifically focuses on supplies for orthodontic treatment using aligners.
tenders.what_they_want: Orthodontic supplies and aligner treatment products (aligners) for orthodontic treatments at the dental center.

tenders.original_title: Germany – Construction work for buildings relating to health
tenders.english_summary: The Deutsche Rentenversicherung Nordbayern is planning to merge two existing rehabilitation clinics into a new rehabilitation center to be built in Bayreuth, Germany. tenders.english_summary: This is a tender for the supply of operating and procedure tables for Nemocnica Poprad hospital in Slovakia. The procurement is divided into two parts: Part 1 for general operating and procedure tables, and Part 2 for an operating table with a full carbon board/plate.
tenders.what_they_want: Part 1: Operating and procedure tables (operačné a zákrokové stoly). Part 2: Operating table with full carbon board/plate (operačný stôl s celokarbónovou doskou). Detailed specifications are provided in Annex C of the tender documents.

tenders.english_summary: Open telematic procedure for the supply under service contract of 3 highly automated diagnostic systems for infectious disease testing, to be installed at Clinical Pathology Units in the hospitals of Acireale, Caltagirone, and Paternò. The contract duration is 5 years, renewable for an additional 2 years, with possible extensions.
tenders.what_they_want: 3 highly automated diagnostic systems/instruments for infectious disease determinations (determinazioni infettivologiche), to be supplied under service contract arrangement

tenders.english_summary: Tender for an angiography device for a hybrid operating room capable of performing combined vascular procedures using both surgical and endovascular approaches. The device must also be suitable for standalone vascular and non-vascular interventions in interventional radiology and interventional cardiology. Construction work is included as part of the contract.
tenders.what_they_want: Angiography device/system designed for combined vascular procedures in hybrid operating room setting, suitable for both interventional radiology and interventional cardiology procedures (specific model numbers and brands not mentioned). Related construction work is included per Annex 9 of tender documentation.

tenders.english_summary: The University Hospital Jena requires the delivery, installation, and commissioning of a regional deep hyperthermia system for the Department of Radiation Therapy and Radiation Oncology. The system will be used for controlled, homogeneous heating of deep-lying tumor tissue as part of multimodal cancer treatment concepts.
tenders.what_they_want: Regional deep hyperthermia system with multiple individually adjustable application units, software-supported planning and simulation solution for patient-specific therapy preparation, all necessary accessories and peripheral components, integration with existing radiological planning and information systems, room and integration concept, general contractor services for installation including electrical, IT, ventilation, climate control and shielding technology work, commissioning, safety testing, acceptance procedures, and training for medical and technical personnel.

tenders.english_summary: The University Hospital of Jena, Germany is procuring a regional deep hyperthermia system for the Department of Radiation Therapy and Radio-Oncology. The system will be used for controlled, homogeneous heating of deep-lying tumor tissue as part of multimodal cancer treatment concepts and must be integrated into existing radiological therapy infrastructure.
tenders.what_they_want: A regional deep hyperthermia system with multiple individually movable application units; software-supported planning and simulation solution for patient-specific therapy preparation; all required accessories and peripheral components; integration into existing radiological systems (planning and information systems); general contractor services including installation, commissioning, room and integration concept, construction work, electrical/IT/ventilation/climate/shielding technology measures, safety testing, acceptance procedures, and staff training for medical and technical personnel.

tenders.english_summary: This is a procurement tender for triple-chamber cardiac pacemakers with included placement accessories, a programmer for adjustments with updates, MRI compatibility, and an automatic telecardiology system. The system will operate on a consignment basis with a single supplier award.
tenders.what_they_want: Triple-chamber cardiac pacemakers with placement accessories included, programmer necessary for adjustments with updates, MRI-compatible devices, automatic telecardiology system, all references, operating on consignment/deposit-sale basis (dépôt-vente), single supplier award (monoattributaire).

tenders.original_title: Germany – Diagnostics and radiodiagnostic devices and supplies
tenders.english_summary: University Hospital Halle (Saale) is procuring a blood irradiation device / X-ray irradiation system for blood products for their transfusion medicine department. The procurement includes replacing an existing system with a radioactive source with an X-ray-based system due to safety and cost considerations.
tenders.what_they_want: Blood irradiation device / X-ray irradiation system for blood products. Optional components include disposal of existing radiation source and old equipment, plus a 3-year maintenance contract after warranty period expires.

tenders.english_summary: This is a tender for the supply of laboratory reagents from brands including Waters, Millipore, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Thermo Scientific (or equivalent) and small laboratory equipment for the University Center for Omics Research at Wroclaw Medical University. tenders.what_they_want: Part 1: Laboratory reagents from Waters, Millipore, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Thermo Scientific or equivalent products (specific items detailed in Annex 2). Part 2: Small laboratory equipment including: ceramic beads 1.4mm (1 pack), laboratory tubes with caps and sealing rings 500pcs (3 packs), pipette tips 50-1200μl (45 packs), pipette tips 0.1-10μl (60 packs), universal pipette tips 5-350μl (118 packs), 96-well microbiological plates in black (4 packs), 96-well laboratory filtration plates 10kDa (12 packs), 96-well ultrafiltration plates 350µL capacity MWCO.

tenders.what_they_want: Specialized surgical instruments and equipment for surgical operations, including both single-use (disposable) and reusable items. Detailed product specifications are contained in Annex 5 (product and price form) of the tender documents.

tenders.english_summary: The Vienna Health Association is procuring one magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) system for the Vienna General Hospital (AKH Wien). The contract includes delivery, installation, user training, technician training (one-time call), and commissioning of the equipment.
tenders.what_they_want: One (1) magnetic resonance tomography system (MRI scanner) including delivery, installation, user training, technician training, and commissioning at AKH Wien (Vienna General Hospital).

tenders.english_summary: This is a French medical supplies tender for various endoscopic and gastrointestinal procedure consumables. tenders.english_summary: This is a tender for the procurement of cardiac defibrillators by a French hospital support establishment. The procurement includes both single-chamber and triple-chamber cardiac defibrillators, with quantity thresholds specified in the consultation documents.
tenders.what_they_want: Single-chamber cardiac defibrillators (DEFIBRILLATEUR CARDIAQUE SIMPLE CHAMBRE) and triple-chamber cardiac defibrillators (DEFIBRILLATEUR CARDIAQUE TRIPLE CHAMBRE). No specific model numbers or brands mentioned.

tenders.english_summary: This is a tender for ongoing supply of draping sets used for patients during the insertion of intravenous ports at Fakultní nemocnice Motol a Homolka hospital in the Czech Republic.
tenders.what_they_want: Draping sets for patients during intravenous port insertion procedures (sterile draping kits for catheter/port placement)

tenders.what_they_want: Portable advanced pulse oximeters with alarm functionality for home environment use, designed to monitor oxygen saturation and pulse rate in the home setting.

UPDATE MONDAY 23 SEPTEMBER 2024: PLEASE NOTE THIS DPS IS NOW OPEN TO NEW APPLICATIONS.
       
      The ASC23043 - Positive Behaviour Support Supported Living Services in Herefordshire & Worcestershire DPS (Dynamic Purchasing System) is now open to new applications until the end of the DPS term, however as stated in the tender documents evaluation will take place in rounds which will be advertised through In-Tend. Indicative timescales for evaluating Round 2 will be advertised on the project page at a later date. 
      
      Initial advert:
      Worcestershire County Council ('the Council') and the NHS Worcestershire and Herefordshire Integrated Care Board ('ICB'), together the Participating Authorities are establishing a joint Dynamic Purchasing System ('the DPS') for the provision of Positive Behaviour Support (PBS) Supported Living Services in Herefordshire and Worcestershire and seek applications from suitably experienced, qualified and appropriately accredited Suppliers who wish to pre-qualify for this Service. 
      
      This DPS is a 3 stage process. In order to be added to the DPS, a Supplier will be required to meet selection criteria and minimum standards as requested in the SSQ Questionnaire (Stage 1), and Evaluation (Stage 2). Any Supplier who meets and passes Stage 1 and 2, will be admitted on to the DPS and will be invited to participate in future opportunities to be known as Mini Competitions (generally for scheme/cluster placements) or Referrals (for individual placements) (Stage 3), which will be advertised as explained in Appendix 2 - DPS agreement.
      
      There are no maximum number of suppliers.
      Suppliers have the option to apply to join the DPS at any time, however, the evaluation may take place in periodic 'rounds' to be determined by the Commissioner.
      
      Your application needs to be submitted by 13th June 2024, 4pm to be considered for Round 1.

tenders.title: Mental Health Recovery
tenders.description:
The Council is seeking applications from experienced providers with the capability and capacity to deliver community mental health care and support in Rotherham.  

A review of current mental health care and support provision in Rotherham indicates the need to improve the community service model to one which offers mental health recovery support personalised social care, with increased choice and control for people living with mental ill-health.  

This new care and support model has been co-produced in partnership with people accessing services and their supporting professionals to inform the service design. 
Such services will support people to achieve independent living skills, move towards, and sustain, independent living in the communities in which they live. 

Aiming to harness the opportunities which exist in the wider care and support market, this Mental Health Recovery Flexible Purchasing System (FPS) will increase choice and improve outcomes for people living with mental ill-health in Rotherham.  

Applicants can read the Cabinet Paper dated 17th October 2022 Commissioning Mental Health Recovery Focused Community Services - Rotherham Council which sought the approval for the procurement process to establish this FPS and procure a range of community services which reflect the principles of mental health recovery model. 

The FPS will comprise of a number of separate Lots.  Each Lot will specify a community service (i.e., supported living accommodation-based services, day opportunities) with the principle of mental health recovery at its core. 

The contract end date specified is provided as an indication only , the system can continue beyond the 5 years as per the rules and subject to cabinet approval.

Applicants are advised that the indicative spend activity to be generated via the system is in the region of £4m per annum, there is no new funding for developing the initiatives proposed. The cost associated with this Flexible Purchasing System will be met within existing budgets currently set at £5.7m (2022-2023).  

Applicants are required to register with the Social Value Portal and commit to delivering Social Value additionality via all contracts awarded via the system.

tenders.title: Health Checks DPS
tenders.description:
The NHS Health Check programme aims to reduce avoidable premature mortality by early identification and management of cardiovascular risk factors and disease in people aged between 40 and 74 years who have no previous history of CVD disease. In West Northamptonshire, 73 in every 100,000 people die prematurely before the age of 75 from cardiovascular disease.

Under the Health and Social Care Act 2012, local authorities have a legal responsibility to commission and monitor a local NHS health check programme. All local authorities must offer an NHS Health Check to 100% of their eligible population every 5 years by inviting 20% of the eligible population each year over the five-year period. In Northamptonshire, between 2024/2025 and 2028/29, 247,499 people are eligible for a NHS Health Check meaning that 49,500 people should be offered a check each year. The Councils aspiration is for 70% of Health Checks offered to be taken up, which equates to around 34,650 checks delivered each year. Office of Health Improvement and Disparities (OHID) expect that 66% of health checks offered should be taken up equating to 27,417 checks delivered each year.

Contract end date: 23rd Feb 2029
